description:
Short episodes included in the "Code Geass DVD Magazine".

Each issue (two in total) includes one episode of the following:
- Code Geass Best Phrase Award
- Code Geass Secret Note
- Sayoko no Nikkichou
- Lelouch-sensei no Britannia-shi Kouza
- BABA Gekijou
